highlights.title: Agents that keep stopping
highlights.line: An agent that stops right after each start now shows Keeps stopping on its card. With Kosmos+ phone notifications on, your phone is told.

highlights.title: An honest sign-in warning
highlights.line: When a Claude sign-in ends but its agents can work a few more hours, the warning now says when they stop, not that they already have.

highlights.title: Work you can check off
highlights.line: New agents are told to put bigger work on a task, with "Done when" checks you can answer yes or no. Existing ones are offered it.

highlights.title: Files come to your device
highlights.line: Over Kosmos+, clicking a file now downloads it to the device you are using, instead of opening it on the computer running Kosmos.

highlights.title: New agent stays in reach
highlights.line: On a phone, before you have any agents, a notice at the top no longer covers the New agent button.
